seo.meta_description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is owned by Blackstone, which acquired the chain in 2024 for nearly $2 billion. Here's the ownership history and key facts.

question: Who Owns Tropical Smoothie Cafe?
quick_answer: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is owned by Blackstone, the global private equity firm, which acquired the chain in 2024 in a deal worth nearly $2 billion. Before that it was owned by Levine Leichtman Capital Partners. Tropical Smoothie Cafe was founded in 1997 in Destin, Florida.
key_facts: Previous owner: Levine Leichtman Capital Partners

body.heading: Who owns Tropical Smoothie Cafe now?
body.text: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is owned by Blackstone, one of the world's largest private equity firms. Blackstone agreed to acquire the chain in April 2024 and completed the deal later that year, in a transaction reported at close to $2 billion. Blackstone backed the purchase to help the fast-growing franchisor keep expanding.

body.heading: Ownership history
body.text: Tropical Smoothie Cafe was founded in 1997 in Destin, Florida. As it grew into a national fast-casual brand, it passed through private-equity hands: BIP Capital and later Levine Leichtman Capital Partners (which acquired it in 2019) owned it before Blackstone's 2024 purchase. It operates mostly as a franchise, with the vast majority of cafes run by franchisees.

body.heading: What does Blackstone's ownership mean?
body.text: Private-equity ownership like Blackstone's is typical for a scaling franchise chain: the owner provides capital and growth expertise while the brand keeps opening new cafes. For customers, day-to-day operations and the menu stay the same; ownership mainly affects the company's expansion and finances.

faqs.q: Is Tropical Smoothie Cafe publicly traded?
faqs.a: No. Tropical Smoothie Cafe is privately owned by Blackstone, which acquired it in 2024. It does not trade on a stock exchange.

faqs.q: When did Blackstone buy Tropical Smoothie Cafe?
faqs.a: Blackstone agreed to acquire Tropical Smoothie Cafe in April 2024 and completed the deal that year, in a transaction worth nearly $2 billion.

faqs.q: Where was Tropical Smoothie Cafe founded?
faqs.a: Tropical Smoothie Cafe was founded in 1997 in Destin, Florida, and has grown into a national franchised chain.
